title: Approximation by linear sampling operators in Banach spaces
summary: This paper studies approximation properties of linear sampling operators in general Banach lattices $X$. We obtain matching direct and inverse approximation estimates, convergence criteria, equivalence results involving special $K$-functionals and their realizations by sampling operators, as well as strong converse inequalities, which, to the best of our knowledge, have not been previously established for sampling operators even in the classical spaces $L_p$.
